summary.title: Questly — Data Flow & Threat Model
summary.description: STRIDE assessment for Questly, a single FastAPI/Jinja2 classroom app. AI generation and production code execution are stubs; classroom SQL persistence is pending OPS-15.

threats.title: Student session theft
threats.description: A stolen session can submit code or expose Classroom data as that Student.
threats.mitigation: Use secure, rotated sessions, revocation, login rate limits, and CSRF tokens.

threats.title: Instructor account takeover
threats.description: Account takeover could expose lecture PDFs, Drafts, and hidden Test Cases.
threats.mitigation: Protect sessions, rate-limit login, verify accounts, and audit Instructor actions.

threats.title: Admin privilege misuse
threats.description: A compromised Admin could change roles, deactivate users, or alter AI settings.
threats.mitigation: Apply least privilege and audit privileged actions.

threats.title: Classroom authorization bypass (IDOR)
threats.description: Changing a resource ID may expose another user's data if membership or ownership checks are missed.
threats.mitigation: Authorize every use case in services; test all role and membership boundaries.

threats.title: CSRF on state-changing requests
threats.description: A logged-in user's browser could be induced to submit a form.
threats.mitigation: Require CSRF tokens on every POST page handler and use SameSite cookies.

threats.title: Request / upload exhaustion
threats.description: Repeated requests or oversized PDFs can exhaust application or storage resources.
threats.mitigation: Rate-limit; cap uploads; use timeouts, concurrency limits, and monitoring.

threats.title: Core data disclosure or tampering
threats.description: Over-privileged DB credentials or unsafe queries could expose or alter accounts, Classrooms, Assignments, or Submissions.
threats.mitigation: Use least privilege, parameterized queries, encrypted DB connections, backups, and audit logs.

threats.title: Private PDF exposure
threats.description: A public bucket, guessable key, or missing owner check could expose lecture PDFs.
threats.mitigation: Keep R2 private; authorize by owner; validate files; use short-lived signed access only when required.

threats.title: Cross-owner retrieval / prompt injection
threats.description: A retrieval defect could return another Instructor's chunks; malicious PDF text may influence future AI output.
threats.mitigation: Filter by document ownership; treat PDF text as untrusted; verify citations.

threats.title: Lecture content sent to provider
threats.description: When connected, prompts and retrieved lecture text may leave Questly or be retained externally.
threats.mitigation: Review provider retention terms, minimize personal data, and scope retrieval to authorized documents.

threats.title: Untrusted code escapes isolation
threats.description: A future runner without strong isolation could compromise the host; production runner is currently a stub.
threats.mitigation: Before enabling execution, use a no-network sandbox with strict CPU, memory, time, output, and filesystem limits.

threats.title: Unauthorized Instructor action
threats.description: A stolen session or failed ownership check could permit publishing or document access.
threats.mitigation: Verify Instructor accounts; enforce ownership; audit publishing and membership changes.

threats.title: Session theft / request forgery
threats.description: Sessions may be exposed if transport or cookie protections are misconfigured.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies, CSRF checks, rotation, and login limits.

threats.title: Admin action repudiation
threats.description: Without reliable audit records, a privileged account could deny changing roles or settings.
threats.mitigation: Log actor, action, target, time, and outcome; protect logs from alteration.

threats.title: Database tampering / disclosure
threats.description: Compromised credentials or unsafe queries could enable unauthorized reads or writes.
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries, least-privilege roles, encryption, and auditing.

threats.title: Object storage disclosure
threats.description: A public bucket, predictable key, or missing authorization could expose teaching material.
threats.mitigation: Keep R2 private; authorize by owner; validate uploads; avoid logging file contents.

threats.title: Cross-owner vector retrieval
threats.description: A retrieval filter defect could return another Instructor's document chunks.
threats.mitigation: Apply ownership filters before retrieval reaches generation; add isolation checks.
